findings: Activation enumerates up to 501 positions per building across an uncapped nearestObjects result; tests 24 bearings per position and low/front/side/rear cover. This work is not suitable for direct copy into the bounded owner callback.

Candidate firing watch uses eye-height ASL. Medic prefers covered interior, MG/marksman/observer favour field of fire and height; rifle/AT actors may take close perimeter patrol. Raw height or role order alone does not reproduce this intent.

Walking tick still setPosATL snaps actors within 2 m, before doStop/PATH lock. Optional stuck teleport also exists; neither is adopted. Medical return and displaced-post retries reset progress clocks and issue broad policy writes.

Static and turret MANNED require actual gunner/turretUnit. Boarding timeout fallback applies only to source WAYPOINT and only ASSIGNED status; a later dismount from MANNED has no replacement transition. External yield unassigns without exact native assignment receipt. These are not sufficient CBE lifecycle contracts.

Current CBE arrival watch used getPos [50,bearing], whose alternative syntax returns ground-level Z. This loses upstairs eye altitude and incorrectly follows remote terrain height. Repair only the existing interior watch endpoint in ASL using actual eyePos, then ASLToAGL at endpoint; preserve existing bearing, range, arrival/authority guards, exterior observation and release.

garrisonPostGeometry20261030.scope: Read full CortexCoverScreened and BuildingRoofTop bodies; selected CortexFindCover header/admission1-82 and candidate/outside/roof/screening119-147; selected CortexGarrison planning126-142. Not a new whole-function review of every descendant.
reusable: CortexCoverScreened already accepts arbitrary validated ASL endpoints, actor/source exclusions and COVER/CONCEALMENT. It can screen a proposed post against a known threat without moving an actor. It uses one terrain check and at most one object ray with four returned surfaces and excludes human-body screening. It supplies neither a firing field nor accessibility/occupation proof.

BuildingRoofTop already derives one world-ASL top endpoint above all eight transformed bounding-box corners. It is read-only and adds no geometry query. Current clearance and indoor traversal use it; garrison planning does not yet.
garrisonPostGeometry20261030.notReusableAsInteriorAllocator: CortexFindCover constructs terrain-level proposals outside the selected object bounds, rejects an overhead hit on that object and checks outdoor support/occupancy before screening. Its 16-post search is not an interior garrison slot allocator; do not move interior actors to its exterior return as a role-scoring shortcut.
garrisonPostGeometry20261030.specificUnmetRequirement: CortexGarrison classifies roofed positions with a fixed positionASL+1 to positionASL+15 ray. A roof above that interval is not tested, so a tall/scaled/tilted building can be sorted as exposed even when it has an overhead roof. This is a post-classification gap, not a demonstrated cause or fix for historical building-entry failures.
garrisonPostGeometry20261030.nextFiniteImplementation: Reuse BuildingRoofTop once per building during existing bounded garrison admission for the upward roof-ray endpoint, retaining one roof query per candidate and all previous admission/native-order/transform/accessibility/deadline guards. Define explicit refusal/handling for invalid bounds or a non-upward endpoint; do not substitute new permission or a fixed height fallback. Extend the relevant existing geometry regression and full coherent gates. Then build bounded role-aware protection/firing scoring using the appropriate read-only screening observations, without duplicating outdoor FindCover or treating roof/wall scores as path proof.

nearWatchOpening20261030.implementation: In existing CortexGarrisonApplyLocal physical-arrival and exact native movement/owner guard, preserve original exterior exit target. For a real interior building, test the preferred outward bearing first and up to four headings relative to current building yaw. A direction requires5m terrain plus separate VIEW and FIRE clearance, each returning at most one surface. First passing bearing sets the existing50m eye-ASL watch direction; no passing direction keeps the original. Building-free in-place holds do not run the scan. No new target, reveal, fire, movement, job, deadline, setting, message or persistent permission.
nearWatchOpening20261030.lifecycle: Runs only in the existing arrival/PATH-lock command boundary. Current actor is captured before nested numeric forEach to prevent implicit _x type confusion. Locality adoption/physical reapproach retains original current owner/assignment/arrival/command checks; it observes fresh eye/world geometry rather than replaying a clear-probe certificate.
nearWatchOpening20261030.cost: At most5 short terrain checks and10 one-surface object rays per qualifying interior arrival, with lazy checks/early exit. Fresh admission permits at most64 assigned actors. Many simultaneous arrivals can therefore have a bounded additional burst; actual timing and the5%median/10%p95 budget remain unmeasured. No new recurring scanner or search. Not a claim of zero runtime cost.
nearWatchOpening20261030.limits: Near5m clearance is neither long-range firing clearance, projectile/friendly-fire safety, window classification, useful post allocation, room clearance nor guaranteed native facing. Irregular/tilted building openings may not match the sampled yaw headings; live bodies/doors can occlude probes and later geometry can change. Original direction remains fallback, not a failed physical occupation. Bounded role-aware protected/firing posts and actual native handbacks remain open.
